_comment: Which policy rules may BLOCK an apply, and who decided that.
Default for any rule not listed here is 'warn' -- an agent can add a rule to the
Rego and it changes nothing about what ships until a human promotes it.
Every rule below starts at 'warn' because G6 has always run in shadow mode; this
file records that state explicitly instead of leaving it implicit in code.
Promote with: minusctl policy promote <RULE-ID> --by <you> --reason <what you checked>
